claims.statement: In the fleet02/B20 r18 balanced-hub packet with |a|>=3501/8000 and both hub arms >1/(8sqrt(2)), if E_2(S[U,V]S[U,V]^T)>=2^-20 then the full ambient density has essential supremum <92, with arbitrary self blocks and outside couplings retained.
Failure of the E2 payment forces either ||S[U,V]||op<1/(16sqrt(2)) or Frobenius distance to rank one <sqrt(2)/64.

For N_U=[c_U,M] and N_V^T=[c_V,M^T], if the corresponding selected-side range leverage is <=1/2 and the component of M transverse to the normalized hub arm is >=1/64, the full density is <61. If both augmented banks are low-leverage and unpaid, M lies within 1/32 in Frobenius norm of lambda u v^T where u,v are the normalized actual hub arms.

Pay the surviving pivot-star/dominant-heavy-edge packet, an augmented balanced-hub bank with physical range leverage >1/2, or the direct two-arm one-factor packet with arbitrary same-bank self curvature and outside couplings, without post-rotation independence.
